title: Orsen and the Hymn
author: Jonah Coldharbour
blurb: Juniper Villalobos, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
